arxiv-1903-11348.creator: Sanjib Banik, Kalpataru Pradhan, I. Das
arxiv-1903-11348.description: Abstract We investigate the ultra-sharp jump in the isothermal magnetization and the resistivity in the polycrystalline S ​ m 0.5 ​ ( C ​ a 0.5 − y ​ S ​ r y ) ​ M ​ n ​ O 3 Sm_{0.5}(Ca_{0.5-y}Sr_{y})MnO_{3} ( y = 0 , 0.1 , 0.2 , 0.25 , 0.3 , 0.5 ) (y=0,0.1,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.5) compounds.

arxiv-1905-11966.title: A realizability semantics for inductive formal topologies, Church’s Thesis and Axiom of Choice Thanks: Projects EU-MSCA-RISE project 731143 ”Computing with Infinite Data” (CID), MIUR-PRIN 2010-2011 and Correctness by Construction (EU 7th framework programme, grant no. PIRSES-GA-2013-612638) provided
arxiv-1905-11966.creator: Maria Emilia Maietti \rsuper a, Samuele Maschio \rsuper a, Michael Rathjen \rsuper b
arxiv-1905-11966.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Maria Emilia Maietti \rsuper a, Samuele Maschio \rsuper a, Michael Rathjen \rsuper b. We present a Kleene realizability semantics for the intensional level of the Minimalist Foundation, for short mTT , extended with inductively generated formal topologies, the formal Church’s thesis and axiom of choice.

arxiv-2101-01805.title: A collection of cycling problems in linear programming
arxiv-2101-01805.creator: Yaguang Yang
arxiv-2101-01805.description: Abstract This paper provides a set of cycling problems in linear programming. These problems should be useful for researchers to develop and test new simplex algorithms. As a matter of the fact, this set of problems is used to test a recently proposed double pivot simplex algorithm for linear programming.

arxiv-2208-08602.title: Doubly heavy tetraquarks in the chiral quark soliton model
arxiv-2208-08602.creator: Michał Praszałowicz
arxiv-2208-08602.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Michał Praszałowicz. The chiral quark soliton model has been successfully applied to describe the heavy baryon spectrum, both for charm and bottom, leading to the conclusion that the heavy quark has no effect on the soliton. This suggests that replacing a heavy quark by a heavy antidiquark Q ¯ ​ Q ¯ \bar{Q}\bar{Q} in color triplet should give a viable description of heavy tetraquarks. We follow this strategy to compute tetraquark masses.

arxiv-2211-10414.title: Particle creation and the Schwinger model
arxiv-2211-10414.creator: José Navarro-Salas, Silvia Pla
arxiv-2211-10414.description: Abstract We study the particle creation process in the Schwinger model coupled with an external classical source. One can approach the problem by taking advantage that the full quantized model is solvable and equivalent to a (massive) gauge field with a non-local effective action. Alternatively, one can also face the problem following the standard semiclassical route.

arxiv-2303-01571.title: Complexity of Reasoning with Cardinality Minimality Conditions
arxiv-2303-01571.creator: Nadia Creignou, Frédéric Olive, Johannes Schmidt
arxiv-2303-01571.description: Abstract Many AI-related reasoning problems are based on the problem of satisfiability of propositional formulas with some cardinality-minimality condition. While the complexity of the satisfiability problem (SAT) is well understood when considering systematically all fragments of propositional logic within Schaefer’s framework (STOC 1978) this is not the case when such minimality condition is added.

arxiv-2306-01310.title: EPIC: Graph Augmentation with Edit Path Interpolation via Learnable Cost
arxiv-2306-01310.creator: Jaeseung Heo, Seungbeom Lee, Sungsoo Ahn, Dongwoo Kim
arxiv-2306-01310.description: Abstract Data augmentation plays a critical role in improving model performance across various domains, but it becomes challenging with graph data due to their complex and irregular structure. To address this issue, we propose EPIC ( E dit P ath I nterpolation via learnable C ost), a novel interpolation-based method for augmenting graph datasets.

arxiv-2312-16308.title: Symplectic realizations and Lie groupoids in Poisson Electrodynamics
arxiv-2312-16308.creator: Fabio Di Cosmo, Alberto Ibort, Giuseppe Marmo, Patrizia Vitale
arxiv-2312-16308.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Fabio Di Cosmo, Alberto Ibort, Giuseppe Marmo, Patrizia Vitale. We define the gauge potentials of Poisson electrodynamics as sections of a symplectic realization of the spacetime manifold and infinitesimal gauge transformations as a representation of the associated Lie algebroid acting on the symplectic realization.

arxiv-2404-19066.title: Revolutionizing Traffic Sign Recognition: Unveiling the Potential of Vision Transformers
arxiv-2404-19066.creator: Susano Mingwin, Yulong Shisu, Yongshuai Wanwag, Sunshin Huing
arxiv-2404-19066.description: Abstract This research introduces an innovative method for Traffic Sign Recognition (TSR) by leveraging deep learning techniques, with a particular emphasis on Vision Transformers. TSR holds a vital role in advancing driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles. Traditional TSR approaches, reliant on manual feature extraction, have proven to be labor-intensive and costly.

arxiv-2407-04012.title: Transfer of homological objects in exact categories via adjoint triples. Applications to functor categories Thanks: 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification. 18G35, 18G25, 18E99.
arxiv-2407-04012.creator: Sergio Estrada, Manuel Cortés-Izurdiaga, Sİnem Odabaşi
arxiv-2407-04012.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sergio Estrada, Manuel Cortés-Izurdiaga, Sİnem Odabaşi. For a given family { ( q i , t i , p i ) } i ∈ I \{({\rm q}_{i},{\rm t}_{i},{\rm p_{i}})\}_{i\in I} of adjoint triples between exact categories 𝒞 \mathcal{C} or 𝒟 \mathcal{D} , we show that any cotorsion pair in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and 𝒟 \mathcal{D} yield two canonical cotorsion pairs providing a concrete description of objects without using any injectives/projectives object hypothesis.

arxiv-2501-16496.title: Open Problems in Mechanistic Interpretability
arxiv-2501-16496.creator: Lee Sharkey * Apollo Research, Bilal Chughtai * Apollo Research, Joshua Batson Anthropic, Jack Lindsey Anthropic, Jeff Wu Anthropic †, Lucius Bushnaq Apollo Research, Nicholas Goldowsky-Dill Apollo Research, Stefan Heimersheim Apollo Research, Alejandro Ortega Apollo Research, Joseph Bloom Decode Re
arxiv-2501-16496.description: Abstract Mechanistic interpretability aims to understand the computational mechanisms underlying neural networks’ capabilities in order to accomplish concrete scientific and engineering goals. Progress in this field thus promises to provide greater assurance over AI system behavior and shed light on exciting scientific questions about the nature of intelligence.

arxiv-2504-00906.title: Agent S2: A Compositional Generalist-Specialist Framework for Computer Use Agents
arxiv-2504-00906.creator: Saaket Agashe, Kyle Wong, Vincent Tu, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang
arxiv-2504-00906.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saaket Agashe, Kyle Wong, Vincent Tu, Jiachen Yang, Ang Li, Xin Eric Wang. Computer use agents automate digital tasks by directly interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) on computers and mobile devices, offering significant potential to enhance human productivity by completing an open-ended space of user queries. However, current agents face significant challenges: imprecise grounding of GUI elements, difficulties with long-horizon task planning, and performance bottlenecks from relying on single generalist models for diverse cognitive tasks.

arxiv-2506-10880.title: Spectral Analysis of Discretized Boundary Integral Operators in 3D: a High-Frequency Perspective
arxiv-2506-10880.creator: Viviana Giunzioni 1 , Adrien Merlini 2 , Francesco P. Andriulli 1
arxiv-2506-10880.description: Abstract When modeling propagation and scattering phenomena using integral equations discretized by the boundary element method, it is common practice to approximate the boundary of the scatterer with a mesh comprising elements of size approximately equal to a fraction of the wavelength λ \lambda of the incident wave, e.g., λ / 10 \lambda/10 .

arxiv-2509-02387.title: Real-time ML-based Defense Against Malicious Payload in Reconfigurable Embedded Systems DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: The International Conference for High Performance Computing, Networking, Storage, and Analysis; November 16–21, 2025; St. Louis, MO ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/25/11
arxiv-2509-02387.creator: Rye Stahle-Smith, Rasha Karakchi (Advisor)
arxiv-2509-02387.description: Abstract . The growing use of FPGAs in reconfigurable systems introduces security risks through malicious bitstreams that could cause denial-of-service (DoS), data leakage, or covert attacks. We investigated chip-level hardware malicious payload in embedded systems and proposed a supervised machine learning method to detect malicious bitstreams via static byte-level features.

arxiv-2510-00888.title: Compactness of conformal metrics with constant Q Q -curvature of higher order
arxiv-2510-00888.creator: Saikat Mazumdar, Bruno Premoselli
arxiv-2510-00888.description: Abstract . Let k ≥ 1 k\geq 1 be a positive integer and let P g P_{g} be the GJMS operator P g P_{g} of order 2 ​ k 2k on a closed Riemannian manifold ( M , g ) (M,g) of dimension n > 2 ​ k n>2k .

arxiv-2512-18483.title: Insider Threat Detection Using GCN and Bi-LSTM with Explicit and Implicit Graph Representations
arxiv-2512-18483.creator: Rahul Yumlembam, Biju Issac, Seibu Mary Jacob, Longzhi Yang, Deepa Krishnan
arxiv-2512-18483.description: Abstract Insider threat detection (ITD) remains a significant challenge in cybersecurity due to the concealed nature of malicious activities by trusted insiders. This paper introduces a novel post-hoc ITD framework that enhances detection capabilities by integrating explicit and implicit graph structures with a temporal component to analyse user behaviour effectively.

arxiv-2512-25010.title: Bounding regularity of VI m {\mathrm{VI}}^{m} -modules
arxiv-2512-25010.creator: Wee Liang Gan, Khoa Ta
arxiv-2512-25010.description: Abstract . Fix a finite field 𝔽 {\mathbb{F}} . Let VI {\mathrm{VI}} be a skeleton of the category of finite dimensional 𝔽 {\mathbb{F}} -vector spaces and injective 𝔽 {\mathbb{F}} -linear maps. We study VI m {\mathrm{VI}}^{m} -modules over a noetherian commutative ring in the nondescribing characteristic case.

arxiv-2602-16746.title: Low-Dimensional and Transversely Curved Optimization Dynamics in Grokking
arxiv-2602-16746.creator: Yongzhong Xu
arxiv-2602-16746.description: Abstract Grokking—the abrupt onset of generalization long after memorization—challenges standard accounts of how neural networks learn, yet the geometric mechanisms driving this transition remain poorly understood. We propose that grokking corresponds to prolonged confinement on a low-dimensional subspace in weight space, during which transverse curvature barriers accumulate until the trajectory escapes into the generalizing solution.

arxiv-2603-27857.title: CARGO: Carbon-Aware Gossip Orchestration in Smart Shipping

europmc-pmc7408012.creator: Begines B, Ortiz T, Pérez-Aranda M, Martínez G, Merinero M, Argüelles-Arias F, Alcudia A.
europmc-pmc7408012.description: The complexity of some diseases-as well as the inherent toxicity of certain drugs-has led to an increasing interest in the development and optimization of drug-delivery systems. Polymeric nanoparticles stand out as a key tool to improve drug bioavailability or specific delivery...

The use of resequencing microarrays for screening multiple, candidate disease loci is a promising alternative to conventional capillary sequencing. We describe the performance of a custom resequencing microarray for mutational analysis of Congenital Myasthenic Syndromes (CMSs), a

pmc-10502649.title: Modification of the existing maximum residue levels for mefentrifluconazole in various commodities
pmc-10502649.creator: EFSA (European Food Safety Authority), Giulia Bellisai, Giovanni Bernasconi, Luis Carrasco Cabrera, Irene Castellan, Monica del Aguila, Lucien Ferreira, German Giner Santonja, Luna Greco, Samira Jarrah, Renata Leuschner, Javier Martinez Perez, Ileana Miron, Stefanie Nave, Ragnor Pedersen, Hermine Re

Arnhem (NL) Freienbach Branch submitted a request to the competent national authority in Austria to modify the existing maximum residue levels (MRLs) for the active substance mefentrifluconazole in various crops and swine liver and other swine products.

pmc-10572901.title: How Does cGAS Avoid Sensing Self-DNA under Normal Physiological Conditions?
pmc-10572901.creator: Wangli Zheng, Nanhua Chen, François Meurens, Wanglong Zheng, Jianzhong Zhu, Dominic De Nardo
pmc-10572901.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). cGAS is a cytosolic DNA sensor that activates innate immune responses by producing the second messenger 2′3′-cGAMP, which activates the adaptor STING. cGAS senses dsDNA in a length-dependent but sequence-independent manner, meaning it cannot discriminate self-DNA from foreign DNA. In normal physiological conditions, cellular DNA is sequestered in the nucleus by a nuclear envelope and in mitochondria by a mitochondrial membrane. When self-DNA leaks into the cytosol during cellular stress or mitosis, the cGAS can be exposed to self-DNA and activated.

pmc-10747536.title: Impact of Actively Offering Influenza Vaccination to Frail People during Hospitalisation: A Pilot Study in Italy
pmc-10747536.creator: Alessandra Fallucca, Patrizia Ferro, Luca Mazzeo, Luigi Zagra, Elena Cocciola, Roberta Oliveri, Antonino Tuttolomondo, Alida Benfante, Salvatore Battaglia, Nicola Scichilone, Nicola Veronese, Marco Affronti, Mario Barbagallo, Alessandra Casuccio, Francesco Vitale, Vincenzo Restivo, the AOUP Inpatien
pmc-10747536.description: Despite the worldwide recommendations for influenza immunisation, vaccination coverage for patients exposed to the highest risk of severe complications is still far from the optimal target. The need to take advantage of alternative methods to provide vaccination is essential. This study presents a hospital-based strategy which offers influenza vaccination to inpatients at discharge.

pmc-11471119.title: Experiences of Chinese Rheumatoid Arthritis Patients Who Chose Western Medicine, Traditional Chinese Medicine, and a Combination of Treatments: A Study Based on Interviews and Thematic Analysis [Letter]
pmc-11471119.creator: Yilin Jiang, Narina A Samah
pmc-11471119.description: analysis of the lived experiences of Chinese rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients who underwent different treatment approaches: Western Medicine (WM), Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), or a combination of both (integrated treatment). It emphasizes the complexity of treatment decisions among RA patients in China, shaped by a blend of cultural beliefs, personal experiences, and practical considerations.

pmc-12385020.title: Unifying FALD assessment—A call to arms
pmc-12385020.creator: Jacob Y. Cao, Rachael Cordina, Avik Majumdar
pmc-12385020.description: ntext, Seol et al1 should be commended for their timely and comprehensive synthesis of the current evidence on FALD. Their systematic review highlights several noninvasive factors associated with biopsy-proven severe fibrosis, including time since Fontan completion, platelet count, the aspartate aminotransferase to platelet ratio index, Fibrosis-4 index, and Fontan pressure.

pmc-12454900.title: EyeMap: A fusion-based method for eye movement-based visual attention maps as predictive markers of parkinsonism
pmc-12454900.creator: Akshay S, Amudha J, Amitabh Bhattacharya, Nitish Kamble, Pramod Kumar Pal
pmc-12454900.description: EyeMap is a method for visualizing and classifying eye movement patterns using scanpaths, fixation heatmaps, and gridded Areas of Interest (AOIs). EyeMap combines predictions from modality-specific machine learning and deep learning models using a late-fusion technique to produce interpretable gaze representations.

pmc-12469553.title: Nutritional and Phytochemical Characterization of Radish Leaves: A Comprehensive Overview
pmc-12469553.creator: Xiong Geng, Ziyi Gong, Weina Tian, Miaomiao Zhuang, Huayan Shang, Yujie Chen, Jianrong Li, Yanfang Lv, Kaihua Bai, Arun K Bhunia
pmc-12469553.description: Radish is a root vegetable that is widely consumed globally. Radish leaves are typically not consumed and regarded as by-products in agricultural, industrial, and domestic settings. Accumulating evidence suggests that radish leaves possess higher nutritional value compared to their roots, primarily due to their elevated levels of protein, ash, dietary fiber, and ascorbic acid.

pmc-12472052.title: Studying How Calcium Silicate and Radiopacifier Proportions Affect the Physicochemical Properties of Endodontic Calcium Silicate-Based Sealers
pmc-12472052.creator: Raimundo Sales de Oliveira Neto, Guilherme Ferreira da Silva, Tany Carvalho Moreira da Veiga, Stefani Jovedi Rosa, Brenda Stefhany Wilchenski de Souza, Rodrigo Ricci Vivan, Murilo Priori Alcalde, Marco Antonio Hungaro Duarte, Dezhong Zhou
pmc-12472052.description: This study evaluated how varying calcium silicate (30–50%) and radiopacifier (45–65%) ratios affected the physicochemical properties of experimental sealers (P1–P3) compared to Bio-C Sealer, AH Plus Bioceramic, and AH Plus Jet. Properties such as flowability, solubility, and radiopacity were assessed per ISO 6876/2012, and setting time followed ASTM C266-2008.

pmc-12615682.title: Therapeutic efficacy of rehmannioside A on 5×FAD mice in Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-12615682.creator: Yunrong Lai, Hengbo Zhao
pmc-12615682.description: Alzheimer’s disease (AD), characterized by Aβ plaques and cognitive decline, remains a significant therapeutic challenge due to limited efficacy of current pharmacotherapies, while Rehmannioside A (ReA) has shown promising neuroprotective effects against neurodegenerative diseases. This research focuses on investigating the therapeutic effects of ReA on 5×FAD mice, emphasizing its potential application in AD treatment.

pmc-12704157.title: Patient perspectives and priorities in pleural infection: results of the MIST-3 feasibility trial qualitative substudy
pmc-12704157.creator: Eihab O. Bedawi, Rebecca Burney, Sophie Harrad, Shakeeb H. Moosavi, Jack Seymour, Alison M. Condliffe, Emma Hedley, Catherine Henshall, Najib M. Rahman
pmc-12704157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The question addressed by the studyThe optimal treatment for pleural infection is yet to be determined and recruitment to trials can be challenging. Research into patient priorities in pleural infection is lacking.

pmc-13101997.title: Reversible and causal epigenetic information loss in liver aging and disease
pmc-13101997.creator: Roni B Shtark, Naor Sagy, Noga Korenfeld, Maayan Gal, Ido Goldstein, Daniel Z Bar, Brent Stockwell
pmc-13101997.description: The loss of epigenetic information has been proposed as a driver of aging and diseases, but the reversibility and causality of this process remain underexplored. Here, we analyze liver-unique methylation sites—genomic loci that show distinct methylation patterns in the liver compared to other tissues. Upon disease progression, these sites overwhelmingly regress toward the pan-tissue average.

pmc-13159798.title: Primary atopic disorders: Monogenic insights into immunity
pmc-13159798.creator: Bhavi P Modi, Cassandra McDonald, Liam Golding, Leandro BR Da Silva, Catherine M Biggs, Julia Körholz, Elliot L James, Stuart E Turvey
pmc-13159798.description: Modi et al. review how primary atopic disorders, a group of monogenic inborn errors of immunity, reveal fundamental mechanisms regulating allergic inflammation. These human diseases show how disruptions in barrier integrity, immune signaling, cytoskeletal dynamics, and immune tolerance converge to drive severe type 2 inflammation and inform emerging precision therapies.

pmc-13264180.title: Ecthyma gangrenosum in a patient with metastatic leiomyosarcoma undergoing chemotherapy: a case report
pmc-13264180.creator: Grace Getman, Taryn Boucher, Vicki Keedy, Melinda New, Alison Barlow, Lauren Prescott
pmc-13264180.description: Highlights•Pancytopenia from chemotherapy is a risk factor for EG with gynecologic malignancy.•EG commonly presents with painful localized lesions, often in the apocrine areas.•EG often presents with signs of sepsis, and rarely without systemic symptoms.•Prompt initiation of anti-pseudomonal antibiotics are the first line treatment.•Early detection can mitigate the significant morbidity and mortality of EG.

pmc-13605714.creator: Lara Garabedian, Gerbrich E. van den Bosch, Sophie Vanhaesebrouck, Karel Allegaert
pmc-13605714.description: Highlights What are the main findings? In this narrative review, we synthesize the clinical evidence on remifentanil for neonatal intubation, with emphasis on efficacy, safety, dosing, administration technique, and its potential role in INSURE or LISA procedures.Our current practices are informed by a combination of small clinical trials, observational studies, and pharmacological research.
